trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: User asks why money is being deducted from their refund.
steps.text: Hello, refund-ல இருந்து ஏன் காசு cut பண்றீங்கன்னு தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாமா?

steps.purpose: Agent asks for identifier to look up the booking.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா செக் பண்ணலாம். உங்க lead ID அல்லது booking reference சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: User provides lead ID and volunteers context about the cancellation.
steps.text: நான் LD-2003-க்கு call பண்றேன். நான் C-0501 unit புக் பண்ணிருந்தேன், ஆனா family emergency-னால cancel பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details using the provided lead ID.
Return booking details.
Acknowledge booking and ask for the first verification factor.
steps.text: BK-9003 booking-க்காக செக் பண்றேன். Details சொல்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி, verification-க்காக சில details தேவைப்படும். உங்க registered name சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: User provides their registered name.
steps.text: என் பேரு ரமேஷ்.

steps.purpose: Ask for a second verification factor to complete identity verification.
steps.text: நன்றி ரமேஷ். Account verify பண்ண, இன்னொரு detail தேவைப்படும். உங்க date of birth அல்லது registered pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: User provides their date of birth.
steps.text: Date of birth 14th May 1985.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return identity verification result.
Check refund eligibility and deduction details.
Return refund eligibility and deduction details.

result.reason: 15% deduction on provisional allotment cancelled after 15 days

steps.purpose: Explain the deduction based on the tool output.
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது. நீங்க 3,00,000 pay பண்ணிருக்கீங்க. Provisional allotment 15 days-க்கு அப்புறம் cancel பண்றதால, policy படி 45,000 deduction ஆகுது. Refundable amount 2,55,000.

steps.purpose: User restates the deduction figure, asks a clarifying question, and requests a waiver.
steps.text: Wait, 45,000 deduct பண்றீங்களா? 15 days cross ஆனதுனால தான? இத waive பண்ண முடியாதா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the deduction is per policy and cannot be waived.
steps.text: System-ல check பண்ண வரைக்கும், policy படி 45,000 deduction conform. இத waive பண்ண முடியாது.

steps.purpose: User pleads for consideration, showing anxiety as a first-timer.
steps.text: நான் first time புக் பண்றேன், எனக்கு இந்த rules சரியா தெரியல. கொஞ்சம் consider பண்ண முடியாதா?

steps.purpose: Politely reiterate that the policy is strict and only the system amount can be processed.
steps.text: உங்க situation புரியுது. ஆனா refund policy படி system-ல என்ன amount வருதோ அதான் நாங்க process பண்ண முடியும்.

steps.purpose: User hesitates and seeks reassurance about getting the refundable amount.
steps.text: சரி... எனக்கு கண்டிப்பா 2,55,000 திரும்ப கிடைக்குமா? கொஞ்சம் பயமா இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Reassure the user using the system's eligibility result and ask for confirmation to initiate.
steps.text: கவலைப்படாதீங்க. System படி 2,55,000 refund-க்கு eligible. நான் இப்போ refund initiate பண்ணட்டுமா?

steps.purpose: User confirms initiation and asks about the timeline (with STT error).
steps.text: ஆமா, initiate பண்ணிடுங்க. இதுக்கு எத்தன நாள் ஆகும்?

steps.purpose: Answer the timeline question and state the action of initiating the refund.
steps.text: System படி 14 processing days ஆகும். நான் இப்போ initiate பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Initiate the refund for the calculated amount.
Return the refund initiation result.
Provide the refund ID and confirm the timeline and amount.
steps.text: உங்க refund initiate ஆயிடுச்சு. Refund ID RF-8821. System காட்டுற processing time 14 days.

steps.purpose: User restates the figures to confirm their understanding.
steps.text: Okay, 2,55,000 refund-க்கு 14 days processing time, correct? Refund ID RF-8821.

steps.purpose: Confirm the user's understanding and offer further assistance.
steps.text: ஆமாம், சரியா சொன்னீங்க. வேற ஏதாச்சும் உதவி வேணுமா?

steps.purpose: User declines further help and ends the conversation.
steps.text: இல்ல, அவ்ளோ தான். Thank you.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
